stories.headline: Anthropic Rewrites Core Messages API in Rust
stories.blurb: Anthropic completed a five-month rewrite of its Claude Messages API service from Python to Rust, drastically reducing infrastructure latency and boosting service reliability under scaling loads.

stories.headline: OpenAI Countersues Apple Over Alleged Trade Secret Theft
stories.blurb: OpenAI has filed countersuits against Apple claiming trade secret misappropriation, intensifying legal combat between major AI providers and traditional tech titans.

stories.headline: OpenAI Launches Private Inference for Enterprise Customers
stories.blurb: OpenAI began rolling out confidential private inference functionality, allowing organizations to process sensitive workloads without exposing raw input data to host environments.

stories.headline: AI Token Volume Surges 44x as Inference Spend Flattens
stories.blurb: OpenRouter telemetry reveals inference token volume grew 44-fold while user expenditure plateaued, underscoring rapid model efficiency gains and price compression across providers.

stories.headline: Pure x86-64 Assembly LLM Engine Enables Bare-Metal Inference
stories.blurb: Developers released llm.asm, an LLM execution engine written entirely in raw x86-64 assembly language that achieves ultra-lightweight inference directly on system hardware.

stories.headline: Hackers Breach US Air Force Cloud One Platform
stories.blurb: Intruders compromised the US Air Force's primary cloud infrastructure, exposing vulnerabilities in high-security defense department cloud environments.

stories.headline: 1Password Discloses GitHub Breach Compromising Customer Data
stories.blurb: 1Password confirmed an unauthorized breach of its GitHub ecosystem that exposed customer information, triggering emergency incident remediation.

stories.headline: SAP Confirms Source Code Leak Following Cyber Incident
stories.blurb: Enterprise giant SAP acknowledged a security incident involving compromised GitHub repositories following reports of proprietary source code leaks.

stories.headline: Trivy-Action Compromised in CI/CD Supply Chain Attack
stories.blurb: Attackers hijacked the widely deployed trivy-action GitHub Action security scanner to inject credential-stealing malware into automated building pipelines.

stories.headline: Sanctioned Nvidia Blackwell AI Chips Discovered in China
stories.blurb: An investigation revealed shell companies in California procured high-end Nvidia Blackwell accelerators and redirected them to Chinese data centers, circumventing US export restrictions.

stories.headline: AMD Unveils Instinct MI455X Datacenter AI Accelerator
stories.blurb: AMD announced the Instinct MI455X GPU with enhanced scale-out bandwidth to directly challenge Nvidia's dominance in massive datacenter model training.

stories.headline: High-Temp Liquid Cooling Technology Eliminates Datacenter Chillers
stories.blurb: Datacenters implementing 45°C liquid inlet cooling are phasing out legacy mechanical chillers, driving massive reductions in infrastructure energy consumption.

stories.headline: Deno Acquired for $26.5M Following $25.9M Funding
stories.blurb: JavaScript runtime vendor Deno was acquired for $26.5 million—just above its venture capital investment total—securing operational funding for its open-source runtime for another year.

stories.headline: Neuralink Receives FDA Approval for Pivotal Human Trial
stories.blurb: Neuralink secured FDA authorization to advance to pivotal clinical trials, establishing a key regulatory milestone for commercial brain-computer interface deployments.
